title: Path resolved and then used separately (c)
description: The code canonicalises a path with realpath and then opens or deletes that path in a later call. Between the two calls the path can be replaced, so the file that was checked is not the file that is used. This lexical rule flags the resolution; the reviewer checks for the split.
remediation: Open the file first and operate on the descriptor, for example open with no-follow flags, then validate.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: flags the resolution even when an open on the same path follows immediately.
